result.reason: The redline properly extends use rights to Client affiliates and contractors and permits M&A successor transfers, but it omits the required licence-duration protections: paid-up licences must be perpetual and irrevocable, and subscription licences must be terminable only for uncured material breach. It also unnecessarily gives TrueLink the same expanded M&A assignment right, potentially changing Client’s counterparty without consent. The grant should clarify that affiliates and contractors may exercise the licensed rights for Client’s and its affiliates’ business, subject to Client remaining responsible for their compliance.
